source: Jolly v. Eli Lilly & Co., 44 Cal.3d 1103 (1988) — California Supreme Court
wound_addressed: Inconsistent judicial interpretation of when §340.5 discovery period was triggered; courts split on 'actual knowledge' vs. 'reason to suspect' standards
design: 'Reason to suspect' standard established: SOL begins when plaintiff suspects or should suspect that the defendant caused the harm, not when specific knowledge of negligent act is obtained
